paragraphs.text: I have three very quick announcements for you. I would like to start this session with some good news – that this House is very pleased that the Sakharov laureate and the fearless journalist, Andrzej Poczobut, was freed from prison in Belarus a few weeks ago. He has now arrived safely in Poland. We welcome his release and we congratulate the family, the services and the people involved in making this happen.

While we celebrate this moment, it also reminds us of the many political prisoners around the world who remain unfairly imprisoned, and this Parliament will continue to speak out for them and for all those who stand up for freedom in the face of oppression.
Finally, I'd like to inform you that we will welcome Mr Poczobut to address this House in June, next session.

Now, looking ahead to this week, tomorrow at 11:30 we will hold the inaugural ceremony of conferral of the European Order of Merit. This is a chance for all of us to honour those extraordinary individuals who have made significant contributions to European integration and to the promotion and defence of European values. So I would ask that you would be present in this Chamber, dear colleagues, for this important event.

And finally, I'd like to take the opportunity to remind all of you, dear colleagues, of the need for mutual respect during plenary sessions. As Members of this Parliament, we are all required to follow the standards of conduct agreed upon election. This is how we ensure that we continue to work as a House for everyone and deliver for Europeans. And I ask all of you to kindly respect and remember this during your debates here.

paragraphs.text: Now we come to the order of business. The final draft agenda, as adopted by the Conference of Presidents last week on 13 May 2026 pursuant to Rule 163, has been distributed.
With the agreement of the political groups, I wish to put to the House the following proposals for changes to the final draft agenda:

For Wednesday, the 'This is Europe' debate with the Prime Minister of Latvia, Evika Siliņa, scheduled for Wednesday morning, is removed from the agenda. As a consequence, the debate on 'High time to deliver on the single market, providing certainty and predictability for EU businesses and quality jobs', will now take place from 09:00 to 11:50.
We therefore move to changes requested by political groups.

Starting with tomorrow: the PfE Group has requested that Council and Commission statements on 'Terrorist attack in Modena, Italy: urgent need for Member States to scale up action countering domestic Islamism and to tighten criteria for granting citizenship' be added as the third item in the afternoon after the Question Time with the High Representative. So as a consequence, the sitting would be extended to 23:00.
I give the floor to Ms Susanna Ceccardi to move the request on behalf of the PfE Group.

paragraphs.text: Signora Presidente, onorevoli colleghi, l'attentato terroristico compiuto a Modena da Salim El Koudri ci sbatte in faccia una verità che troppi, in quest'Aula, continuano vigliaccamente a negare: l'Europa è sotto assedio dell'islamismo radicale.

Non parliamo soltanto di minacce esterne, ma di soggetti borderline, psicolabili, fanatici che crescono e si radicalizzano nelle nostre città a causa di politiche di integrazione fallimentari portate avanti in questi anni.
È già successo in Francia, in Belgio, in Germania e in Olanda, oggi colpisce l'Italia.

E chi continua a minimizzare ha una responsabilità politica enorme: non c'è spazio per il buonismo ideologico, serve una stretta immediata e durissima contro ogni forma di estremismo. Allo stesso tempo, è indispensabile una svolta radicale sulle politiche migratorie, rendendo molto più severi i criteri per far ottenere la cittadinanza e molto più rapidi quelli per revocarla.
La mia totale solidarietà alle vittime di Modena. Adesso basta parole, basta giustificazioni e basta debolezza: l'Europa non può subordinare la sicurezza dei cittadini al politicamente corretto.

paragraphs.text: Madam President, I would first like to make clear that me speaking against this is not, in any case, a lack of solidarity for the victims of this terrorism attack or support of the terrorists in any kind.

I think it is very important that you know the reasoning of your enemies. If you listen to the reasoning that many terror organisations – from al‑Qaeda to the Islamic State, to other terrorist organisations – gave over and over again, is that they say they want to put a divide between Muslims in Europe and other people in Europe.

I believe one of the root causes for terrorism is that those people were pushed out by the failed integration policies that you rightfully mentioned. So, pushing out people even further, barring them the right to citizenship and to participation will not lead to less terror attacks, but to more terror attacks.
Therefore, I oppose this framing of this debate and I ask the colleagues to vote against it.

paragraphs.text: Madam President, pursuant to Rule 164 and on behalf of the Renew Europe group, I hereby request to include a statement by the Vice-President and High Representative on the EU's response to the reduced US military deployment in Europe, particularly Poland and the eastern flank, on the agenda for this plenary session.

The very recent developments regarding the Trump Administration's policy on US military presence in Europe have raised significant concerns among us. This appears to be a deliberate policy rather than a chaotic series of decisions.

While the last days' focus was on Poland, the implications extend to the entire eastern flank and Europe as a whole. I strongly believe that this issue warrants urgent discussion by the House, specifically addressing how Europe should respond to these latest developments.

paragraphs.text: Señora presidenta, «los afganos no deben pagar el precio de las acciones de los talibanes». «Debemos hacer todo lo que esté en nuestras manos para evitar volver a la edad oscura del régimen talibán». «Estamos con vosotras». «Los derechos de las mujeres deben protegerse»... Estas frases les sonarán familiares porque se han pronunciado aquí, en esta Cámara. Las pronunció nuestra presidenta Metsola, las pronunció el señor Weber y las pronuncié yo misma, y lo hicimos cuando las cámaras enfocaban el sufrimiento del pueblo afgano.

Hoy, cuando las cámaras se han apagado, se invita a los talibanes a Bruselas. Los mismos talibanes que prohíben a las niñas estudiar. Los mismos talibanes que encarcelan a las mujeres en sus propias casas. Los mismos talibanes para los que el precio de una mujer es menor que el de un animal. Y, ahora, la Comisión Europea quiere sentarse con ellos para hablar de las deportaciones.

Europa no puede convertirse en una máquina de expulsión que negocia con verdugos mientras presume de valores, porque si Europa legitima a quienes practican el apartheid de género, entonces no estamos defendiendo nuestros propios valores: los estamos traicionando.

paragraphs.text: Madame la Présidente, je souhaite faire un rappel au règlement sur la base de l’article 10 relatif aux règles de conduite concernant la tenue au sein même du Parlement européen de la conférence intitulée «La gouvernance raciale de la mobilité dans l’Union européenne: réalités actuelles et perspectives à venir», organisée avec l’ENA, dont les proximités avec les réseaux islamistes, et en particulier les Frères musulmans, sont connues et documentées.

Sous couvert de lutte contre les discriminations, cette conférence diffuse un discours de désinformation et de diffamation contre les États européens, en prétendant que nos politiques de contrôle des frontières, de mobilité ou de sécurité reposeraient sur une logique raciale et ségrégationniste. Les documents présentés accusent notamment la France de stigmatisation religieuse pour avoir combattu le séparatisme islamiste et expulsé des imams radicaux. Pourtant, l’Autriche a elle-même pris des mesures contre les Frères musulmans pour protéger l’ordre public et la sécurité nationale.

Les législations européennes et nationales n’ont jamais eu pour objet d’organiser une quelconque ségrégation. Et quelques jours après le vote d’un texte mettant en cause les forces de police, notre Parlement n’a pas vocation à devenir une tribune pour des discours complaisants avec l’islamisme politique.

paragraphs.text: Senhora Presidente, eu e outros 74 deputados deste Parlamento dirigimos à Senhora Presidente e à Conferência de Presidentes o pedido de agendamento de uma sessão plenária extraordinária do Parlamento Europeu para discutir a dramática situação que se vive em Gaza e na Cisjordânia, em consequência da política de agressão do governo israelita.

O governo de Israel continua a assassinar, a destruir infraestruturas básicas, a negar a entrada de ajuda humanitária em Gaza, a perseguir e a expulsar das suas terras a população palestiniana. Aprovou uma lei discriminatória e racista que condena à morte presos palestinianos, e a ausência de ação por parte das instituições da União Europeia é política e moralmente inaceitável e indefensável. E é o rompimento com esse silêncio cúmplice que este Parlamento tem de assumir.
A convocação dessa sessão extraordinária deste Parlamento Europeu é a forma de contribuir para romper com esse silêncio cúmplice.
E é esse o pedido, Senhora Presidente, que lhe fazemos aqui redobradamente para que essa sessão plenária possa ser convocada.

paragraphs.text: Madam President, dear colleagues, I would like to make a point of order pursuant to Rule 40. Yesterday, it was the International Day Against Homophobia, Biphobia, Intersexphobia and Transphobia.

One day earlier, after a performance at Brussels Pride, three artists were attacked and abused by a mob of children around 14 years of age. My heart and solidarity is with Sherine Falasteen, Diva Beirut and Anira Orlando. You deserve to be loved.

Colleagues, I am asking for a moment of solidarity for these victims of a terrible hate crime. But we also need to look at ourselves. We need to do better. All of us need to ensure that hate doesn't have a place in the European Union and to ensure that hate speech doesn't have a place in this House. As long as manosphere bullies are parroted by people in this Parliament, you are complicit to the growing violence against my community.
People in the EU have the right to be themselves and they should never have to choose between being visible or being safe.

paragraphs.text: Senhora Presidente, a liderança firme do presidente do governo dos Açores, José Manuel Bolieiro, mesmo perante movimentos populistas e demagogos, ao não vacilar nem recuar, após anos de trabalho e de diálogo com os vários intervenientes no setor das pescas e economia azul, na definição das áreas marinhas protegidas — cumprindo com cinco anos de antecedência as próprias metas definidas pelas Nações Unidas e também pelas próprias instituições europeias — valeu-lhe agora o reconhecimento através de um prémio internacional Peter Benchley Ocean Awards 2026, conhecido como os Óscares dos oceanos.

Este é, sem dúvida, motivo de grande orgulho para os Açores, enquanto região ultraperiférica da União Europeia e, ao protegerem cerca de 300 000 quilómetros quadrados do seu mar, criaram a maior área marinha protegida europeia até ao momento. Mas é também um orgulho para Portugal e para a União Europeia.

É esta visão estratégica que traz a União Europeia para a liderança em áreas tão importantes da economia azul e da proteção do nosso oceano, respeitando também quem dele vive, desde logo os nossos pescadores.
Bolieiro, com a humildade que o caracteriza, dedicou o prémio aos Açores, mas está Bolieiro de parabéns e estamos todos nós, enquanto portugueses e europeus.

paragraphs.text: Signora Presidente, onorevoli colleghi, il 4 maggio scorso, dopo essere stato diagnosticato con un male incurabile, Olivier Dupuis, già membro di questo Parlamento, ha scelto liberamente di lasciarci all'età di 67 anni.

Olivier Dupuis era di nazionalità belga e fu eletto per due legislature in Italia con il Partito radicale di Marco Pannella. È stato l'incarnazione più riuscita del sogno di un partito e di una politica transnazionale.

Ha combattuto sempre e dappertutto per la difesa della democrazia nel mondo. Nei giorni prima della sua libera partenza lo hanno incontrato o gli hanno scritto ucraini, georgiani, ceceni, russi, tibetani, uiguri, cinesi, laotiani, cambogiani, vietnamiti, tunisini, cubani e molti altri.
A loro, come a noi, come a tutti i democratici europei, Presidente, mancherà moltissimo Olivier Dupuis.

political_group.label: PPE
political_group.name: Group of the European People's Party (Christian Democrats)

interventions.speaker_label: Costas Kadis, Member of the Commission.

paragraphs.text: Madam President, honourable members, Europe is the world's third‑largest producer of steel, with the sector accounting for 300 000 jobs in the EU. This is a critical part of our economy and it is essential that we preserve a strong and sustainable EU steel industry.

However, in recent times, this industry has suffered from unsustainable levels of global overcapacity. To illustrate this problem, by next year, this overcapacity is expected to reach 721 million tonnes, more than five times the EU's annual steel consumption. This has already resulted in the EU steel industry shedding 65 million tonnes in production and as many as 100 000 jobs over the past two decades.

Unfortunately, our efforts to address the problem of overcapacity with like‑minded countries in the context of the Global Forum on Steel Excess Capacity have not delivered satisfactory results. Therefore, we have had to resort to an autonomous measure to provide effective protection to our steel industry after the expiry of the current safeguard measure on 30 June 2026.

I welcome the cooperative approach which resulted in political agreement on this steel measure. A timely adoption and entry into force on 1 July 2026 is now essential to ensure that there is no gap in protection for our industry.

Such a gap would inevitably result in a massive surge of imports of steel into the European Union, leading to stagnating prices, huge stockpiling and ultimately to mass closures on steel producing sites. This would have serious detrimental effects on the EU's steel industry and more generally on our overall industrial policy. Therefore, I trust the European Parliament will strongly support the text.

Let me stress that we are adopting this measure in a way which is consistent with our international trade obligations. Given that some 80 % of our steel imports come from partners with whom we have concluded free trade agreements, they must be covered by the scope of the measure to ensure its effectiveness.

This is not a decision that was taken lightly. However, from the beginning of the process, the EU has been very transparent about what we want to achieve with the measure and how we intend to do it in full respect of the WTO rules. For this reason, the Commission is using the pathway provided by GATT Article XXVIII. This allows the EU to exercise its right to increase its bound tariffs, in this case from 0 % to 50 %, while opening a system of tariff‑rate quotas.

Intense discussions are currently ongoing in Geneva with more than 20 trading partners. This engagement shows that the EU, like other players in the steel sector, is decisively protecting its industry in a fair and transparent manner. In particular, we are engaging closely with our FTA partners. Here, the objective is to make it clear that we seek to minimise the impact of the measure on them within the limits provided in the regulation. In parallel, we will continue the international cooperation to address global steel overcapacity under the Global Forum on Steel Excess Capacity.

Honourable members, let me take this opportunity to express my sincere gratitude for all those involved, including the Chair, the rapporteur and the honourable Members of the INTA Committee, as well as the presidency of the Council for the exemplary work and cooperation in finding a rapid agreement and a workable solution for our steel industry.

This agreement required pragmatism on all sides and I thank the co‑legislators for their flexibility on key issues. The text is very ambitious, matching the level of the challenge our industry is facing, and it illustrates that the EU is able to deliver on fast and ambitious protection for a strategic industry.

paragraphs.text: IN THE CHAIR: ESTEBAN GONZÁLEZ PONS
Vice-President

interventions.text:
IN THE CHAIR: ESTEBAN GONZÁLEZ PONS

Vice-President

political_group.label: PPE
political_group.name: Group of the European People's Party (Christian Democrats)

paragraphs.text: Mr President, Commissioner, colleagues, the strength of Europe's steel industry must be built on trade, competition and innovation – not protectionism. But in a world where some countries pour billions into subsidies while others turn their back on the climate, competition is distorted.

There is a broad political support in this Parliament for futureproofing Europe's steel industry and we are now securing the steel industry as a backbone for our competitiveness, so that investments in innovation and lower emissions will pay off, so that Europe's defence industry is never left without steel, and to achieve stronger rules on 'melt and pour'. It is not enough to know where the bread was baked, you also want to know that the flour was clean. This is necessary for this legislation, but also to prevent sanctions from being circumvented.

So, on the topic of sanctions, I am happy that with this legislation, the Parliament, the Council and the Commission has jointly agreed on putting a sharp and final end to the exemption that still allows for importing steel slabs from Russia. Enough is enough with cheap Russian steel flooding EU markets while funding their war.

Addressing overcapacity, cutting imports from Russia must be the lowest hanging fruit. But at the same time, Ukraine's steel industry is strategically targeted by Russian attacks. Last week I visited the steel plants in Kryvyi Rih, Dnipro, Kamianske and witnessed the brutal reality. Several production facilities are located in occupied areas or have been completely destroyed. Since the full-scale invasion, the remaining production faces enormous costs. The fact that the industry, against all odds, manages to operate under these circumstances must be encouraged, not punished.

Under the current steel safeguard, Ukraine has an exemption supposed to run until summer 2028. And in this new trade measure, Ukraine's situation as a candidate country with special security concerns shall be considered when allocating country quotas. Ukraine's steel production is fundamentally important to their ability to win the war against Russia.

Today, I want to make clear that what we agreed regarding tariff quotas for Ukraine and its special status must be respected. We must treat Ukraine as a future member and a strategic partner to the EU, not as a threat.

So, colleagues, before the vote, I want to ask the Commission, can you promise that this legislation will benefit Ukraine and not harm the backbone of Ukrainian economy? I repeat: will it benefit Ukraine and not harm the backbone of Ukrainian economy in this crucial time?

paragraphs.text: Herr talman! Stål som gjutits och valsats bakom Kinas murar på riggade villkor ska inte slå ut våra bruksorter. Ingen hjälm ska läggas på hyllan för andra länders fulspel. För om Europas ugnar stängs av blir vi svagare. Men det är som att vissa inte hör. De som aldrig känt oron för en hel bygd. Som inte förstår hur ett bruk kan bära upp ett helt samhälle. De som aldrig satt sin fot på bruksorter som Degerfors och Smedjebacken. De tror att vi lever i en värld som inte finns längre.

Men vi måste vakna ur dvalan, inse att vår produktion är under angrepp. Därför borde kammaren rösta ja till det här skyddet. Men det räcker inte. Vi måste också investera för att på allvar ta oss ur den här krisen. Så när Europa kliver in i 30-talet, då ska det nya samhällsbygget vila på balkar av stål från platser som Avesta, Sandviken och Luleå. Platser som Hofors, Boden och Borlänge. Det är dags för bruksorternas revansch.

interventions.speaker_role_in_transcript: on behalf of the PPE Group

paragraphs.text: Mr President, dear colleagues, Europe is confronted with a defining industrial moment. Global steel overcapacity continues to increase, while Europe remains one of the few major open markets. The consequences are tangible – production sites under pressure, weaker investments, declining utilisation rates and thousands of industrial jobs lost across Europe.

But this debate goes beyond steel, as it reflects Europe's industrial identity and the foundation of its cooperation. Without a strong and competitive steel industry, the EU cannot achieve resilience or strategic autonomy. The agreement reached after intensive negotiations provides a necessary and balanced response to these challenges. It strengthens our ability to monitor and react to market distortions, improves transparency to enhance traceability requirements such as 'melt and pour', and acknowledges more clearly the strategic nature of the steel sector for Europe's future.

In this context, it is essential to protect European steel producers from unfair global competition so they can continue to invest, produce and decarbonise with stability, while also ensuring downstream industry and SMEs benefit from a strong and competitive steel base.

This text reflects a strategic choice for Europe. An open Union must also be able to defend its industrial base and preserve critical production capacities in an increasingly fragmented global economy. The future of European industry will be decided by our willingness to act with consistency and responsibility.

interventions.speaker_label: Brando Benifei, a nome del gruppo S&D.

paragraphs.text: Signor Presidente, onorevoli colleghi, senza acciaio europeo non c'è industria europea e senza un'industria forte e di qualità, non c'è futuro per l'Europa, per i suoi lavoratori e per le sue imprese.
Domani approviamo un regolamento di fondamentale importanza, un passo urgente e concreto per difendere il settore siderurgico dagli effetti devastanti della sovraccapacità globale.

Oggi, nel mondo, esiste una capacità produttiva in eccesso di oltre 600 milioni di tonnellate di acciaio, quasi quattro volte l'intera produzione annuale dell'Europa, che è il terzo produttore mondiale e dà lavoro a circa 300 000 persone.

Questa sovraccapacità – sostenuta da sussidi pubblici irregolari e pratiche di dumping – colpisce duramente i produttori europei e mette a rischio i nostri posti di lavoro. Le conseguenze sono evidenti: aumento delle importazioni a prezzi distorti, grave sottoutilizzo degli impianti europei e perdita di competitività.
Dobbiamo reagire.

Con il nuovo regolamento, infatti, riduciamo del 50 % le quote di importazione di acciaio, fissando un tetto massimo di 18,3 milioni di tonnellate annue, introduciamo un dazio del 50 % sulle importazioni che superano tali quote e rafforziamo la tracciabilità per contrastare pratiche di elusione.

Come Socialisti e Democratici ci siamo battuti per ottenere un calendario accelerato per l'estensione della lista dei prodotti coperti da questa salvaguardia e abbiamo dimezzato i tempi per coprire anche i settori a valle – penso all'automotive, alla meccanica, agli elettrodomestici, al settore delle costruzioni e della cantieristica – perché non stiamo difendendo solo l'acciaio, ma l'intera base industriale europea.

L'Unione europea deve abbattere i costi dell'energia, accelerare la decarbonizzazione e sostenere gli investimenti industriali. L'Industrial Accelerator Act sarà essenziale per introdurre criteri obbligatori di origine europea. Solo l'acciaio realmente europeo, realmente prodotto nell'Unione, dovrà beneficiare di questo sostegno.

Insieme ai partner internazionali che condividono le nostre regole dobbiamo costruire un vero perimetro globale di protezione del mercato dell'acciaio: è una questione fondamentale per il presente, ma, ovviamente, anche per il futuro.

paragraphs.text: Panie Przewodniczący! Panie Komisarzu! W ostatnich latach widzimy dwa negatywne trendy, które, nakładając się na siebie, pokazują nam, w jak głębokim kryzysie strukturalnym znajduje się europejski sektor hutniczy. W tym samym czasie produkcja stali w Europie spadła o kilkanaście procent, a jednocześnie import stali do Europy wzrósł również o kilkanaście procent. Komisja Europejska mogłaby oczywiście spytać, dlaczego tak się dzieje. Otóż trzeba powiedzieć jasno i wyraźnie: to również wasza wina – wysokie koszty energii, polityka klimatyczna, dekarbonizacja, ETS – to również wy odpowiadacie za to, że europejska stal jest droższa od tej z zagranicy.

Ale przecież przemysł stalowy to kręgosłup gospodarki i fundament suwerenności przemysłowej każdego rozwiniętego państwa. Sektor ten odgrywa kluczową rolę w przemyśle zbrojeniowym, infrastrukturze, kolei, transporcie, budownictwie, motoryzacji, energetyce i tak dalej. Dlatego właśnie bezpieczeństwo i rozwój tego sektora są szczególnie ważne.

Tymczasem sprawozdania donoszą, że w zeszłym roku europejska produkcja stali spadła do historycznie niskiego poziomu. To już nie są ostrzeżenia, to już jest katastrofa. W tym samym ubiegłym roku całkowity import stali, w tym półproduktów, wzrósł aż o 14%. Skutki polityki Komisji Europejskiej odczuwa szczególnie przeżywający kryzys polski sektor hutniczy. To tysiące miejsc pracy w spółkach serwisowych, logistycznych i u setek lokalnych dostawców. Ale to też upadek dla polskiej innowacji, myśli technicznej i dla bezpiecznego łańcucha dostaw w całej polskiej gospodarce.

Komisja Europejska ze swoimi planami i nierealnymi klimatycznymi ambicjami jest głównym hamulcowym rozwoju gospodarek państw członkowskich. To, czego potrzebuje europejski przemysł stalowy, to wzmocnienie jego konkurencyjności przez rozwiązanie strukturalnych przyczyn problemów, w jakim się znalazł, a nie pudrowanie rzeczywistości.

paragraphs.text: Signor Presidente, onorevoli colleghi, sosteniamo l'accordo sull'acciaio, ma – diciamolo – manca coraggio.

Avremmo voluto da subito l'inclusione dei prodotti allegati dell'acciaio, perché imprese e lavoratori non possono aspettare e il mercato non aspetta la burocrazia. Rinviare di sei mesi non risponde alla realtà dei nostri distretti industriali, è un tempo che diventa un costo pesante per chi produce, investe e dà lavoro.
Chiediamo alla Commissione un impegno preciso: includere i prodotti degli allegati entro dicembre 2026, senza ulteriori rinvii e senza ambiguità.

Già nel 2016 il Presidente Juncker denunciava le difficoltà dell'acciaio. Sono passati dieci anni. Intanto, attori extraeuropei distorcono il mercato, fanno concorrenza sleale e ci invadono con prodotti a basso costo. Ogni ritardo ingiustificato non è neutrale, ha un prezzo: le imprese pagano, le industrie pagano, i lavoratori pagano.
Lo diciamo con forza: senza acciaio, non c'è industria; senza industria, non c'è autonomia strategica; senza autonomia strategica, l'Europa resta dipendente, fragile e meno competitiva.

paragraphs.text: Monsieur le Président, quand l’Europe veut, l’Europe peut. L’Europe peut protéger nos emplois, nos industries, notre autonomie face à l’afflux massif d’acier bradé par des Chinois qui ne savent que faire de leur surcapacité. Plutôt que de laisser détruire nos filières, plutôt que de créer de nouvelles dépendances, l’Europe a décidé d’agir et de réduire les quotas d’importation de moitié tout en doublant les droits de douane au-delà de ces quotas. Et c’est une excellente nouvelle. Cela montre que, contrairement à ce que certains prétendent, quand l’Europe veut, elle peut.

Mais nous devons aller jusqu’au bout de la logique et mettre aussi des droits de douane sur les voitures importées avec ce même acier bradé et polluant. Je vous rappelle que les voitures, c’est en effet 15 % de l’acier produit dans le monde et les constructeurs qui fabriquent en Chine économisent 500 euros par voiture grâce à cet acier bon marché et polluant.

Alors bien sûr, certains constructeurs, y compris européens – BMW, Mercedes ou d’autres – qui produisent beaucoup en Chine sans parfois se soucier de l’avenir de l’Europe, viendront peut-être se plaindre et faire pression. Mais vous ne pensez pas qu’il est temps d’arrêter de se faire avoir et de protéger l’intérêt de nos territoires plutôt que les leurs? Ne soyons pas dupes, protégeons les Européens, leur bien-être, leur avenir. Ce n’est pas le job des multinationales de les protéger; c’est le nôtre.

paragraphs.text: Voorzitter, collega’s, we stemmen over iets dat honderdduizenden staalarbeiders in Europa gaat helpen. En ook vele duizenden in België. Want China overspoelt onze markt met goedkoop gesubsidieerd staal. En Trump voert een handelsoorlog waardoor er nog meer van dat staal onze richting uitkomt.

Onze staalfabrieken, zoals in Gent en elders in Europa, worstelen vandaag om te overleven. En arbeiders verliezen hun job. De vraag is dus simpel: doen we daar iets aan? Of laten we de sector gewoon uitsterven? Tonen we als Europa eindelijk een ruggengraat ten opzichte van Trump of laten we ons weer doen?

Stemmen we “ja”, dan stoppen we de massale dumping van staal op onze markt. We beschermen onze jobs en we gaan voor staal made in Europe. En vooral maken we nieuwe investeringen mogelijk om onze fabrieken te moderniseren en ook om hun klimaatuitstoot eindelijk aan te pakken. Ik stem “ja” omdat ik vind dat we een staalindustrie in Europa nodig hebben. Omdat ik vind dat onze staalarbeiders een toekomst verdienen.

paragraphs.text: Monsieur le Président, fermer des aciéries en Europe, alors que l’acier est le cœur de toute notre industrie, ce n’est pas juste une crise, c’est l’effondrement de nos propres fondations. Alors oui, il faut des barrières commerciales pour le secteur. Enfin l’Union européenne s’éveille au protectionnisme solidaire que nous réclamons depuis des décennies pour défendre les travailleurs, nos savoir-faire et notre autonomie.

Mais on ne peut pas s’arrêter là. On doit activer d’autres leviers, tels que l’accélérateur industriel qui est justement en cours de négociation. Dans ce texte, disons-le clairement, la commande publique doit être fléchée vers l’acier décarboné produit sur notre sol. Arrêtons l’hypocrisie. On ne peut pas estampiller du made in Europe tout ce qui est produit à l’autre bout du monde via des accords de libre-échange. Cela n’a aucun sens.

Et puis quand l’urgence est là, face au chantage, à la délocalisation de quelques géants – je pense notamment à ArcelorMittal en France – il faut avoir du courage politique et nationaliser nos actifs stratégiques. Donc oui, il est temps de reprendre la main sur notre destin industriel. Car produire en Europe aujourd’hui, c’est garantir notre indépendance, c’est réussir la bifurcation écologique et c’est tout simplement exister demain.

paragraphs.text: Monsieur le Président, en amour, on dit que c’est quand quelqu’un n’est plus là qu’on prend soudain conscience de sa valeur. Dans cet hémicycle, c’est la même chose. Après avoir méprisé et même martyrisé notre industrie, vous commencez à la regretter. Transformer des métaux, fabriquer de l’acier, ce n’était plus très à la mode ici. Depuis des décennies, vous avez donc multiplié les normes pour rendre la sidérurgie un peu moins polluante et beaucoup plus coûteuse. Résultat: le continent qui a inventé la sidérurgie moderne ne représente plus que 8 % de la production mondiale. La Chine produit désormais à elle seule 55 % de l’acier mondial, en polluant beaucoup plus que nous ne le faisions. Les émissions globales sur la planète n’ont donc pas diminué, bien au contraire. Mais notre industrie, elle, l’a payé très cher.

Et maintenant? Maintenant, la Commission européenne est en pleine prise de conscience et nous propose aujourd’hui de doubler les droits de douane sur les importations d’acier chinois. Rappelons ceci: le libre-échange et la compétition sont mutuellement profitables quand ils s’inscrivent dans un cadre loyal. Or, avec la Chine, nos entreprises sont en concurrence non pas avec d’autres entreprises, mais avec un État plus vaste et plus peuplé que tout notre continent qui conquiert des marchés sans jamais ouvrir les siens, ce qui est la définition d’une concurrence ni libre, ni loyale, mais totalement faussée. Il n’y a donc pas de naïveté à avoir. Il faut assumer de protéger notre industrie et de pratiquer le libre-échange avec ceux qui en acceptent les règles.

Alors, que faut-il faire? D’abord, baissons massivement les coûts: les coûts de l’énergie, les coûts du travail, les charges, les normes. Supprimons les impôts de production. Ensuite, produisons notre propre énergie, car l’énergie pèse pour 40 % du prix de l’acier. La solution? Le nucléaire, encore et toujours, seule source compétitive, décarbonée et souveraine. Enfin, protégeons ce qui peut l’être, mais intelligemment. Bref, libérons notre économie à l’intérieur et protégeons-la de la concurrence déloyale à l’extérieur.

paragraphs.text: Mr President, Commissioner, Europe's success has always depended on its export opportunities. From coal and steel to today's global leadership in agri-food and manufacturing, openness has made Europe prosperous.

And it will remain the path to our success. Turning inward could never be the answer. But when major players refuse to play by the rules and when every available instrument has been exhausted, there are cases where action becomes necessary and steel is one of those cases.

I am happy that the agreement before us now provides greater flexibility for our downstream industries, because we cannot protect one part of the supply chain while harming another. Europe's competitiveness depends not only on steel producers, but also steel users that rely on affordable and reliable inputs.

I regret that we could not find a better solution for Ukraine. I urge the Commission to pursue generous quotas so that Ukraine can continue to trade and maintain economic resilience, in line with our continuing support for Ukraine.

Finally, at a time when major economies are turning to industrial policy and protectionism, Europe must remain careful not to undermine the very principles that built our prosperity: competitive advantage, open markets and free trade. These principles lower costs, raise living standards and help deliver the products we need for a green and digital transition.

political_group.name: Group of the European People's Party (Christian Democrats)

paragraphs.text: Senhor Presidente, Senhor Comissário, caras e caros colegas, a abertura comercial da Europa é uma das suas grandes forças no plano internacional e constitui uma enorme vantagem do ponto de vista económico. Vemos, por isso, com preocupação crescente o ressurgimento de um discurso ultraprotecionista que pode ser popular, mas nos parece contrário aos interesses europeus.

Não ignoramos, contudo, que é necessário proteger determinados setores estratégicos. As medidas globais de salvaguarda do aço expiram no final do próximo mês, e é necessário aprovar um novo mecanismo — sobre isso não há a mais pequena dúvida.

Receamos, contudo, que se tenha seguido por um caminho demasiado restritivo, que acabe por prejudicar as empresas de um setor transformador altamente eficiente, competitivo e de maior valor acrescentado.

Reconhecemos que o acordo final significa um avanço quando comparado com a proposta inicial da Comissão Europeia, que não ignora as preocupações que atrás referi e que introduz mesmo a necessidade de avaliação do impacto desta regulação na restante cadeia de valor.

A Comissão Europeia tem agora a obrigação de vigiar os eventuais efeitos negativos desta legislação na indústria transformadora, que, em países como Portugal, é sinónimo de sucesso económico e de grande desenvolvimento tecnológico.

Devemos, por isso, recusar a ideia de uma Europa fortaleza. Temos, isso sim, de estabelecer e aprofundar relações com países e zonas do mundo que partilhem connosco referências e valores. E é por isso mesmo que parcerias como, por exemplo, aquela que acabou agora de entrar em vigor no âmbito do Acordo Mercosul são vitais para o futuro da União Europeia.

paragraphs.text: Senhor Deputado Francisco Assis, a propósito destas medidas de proteção da produção do aço, queria fazer-lhe duas perguntas muito concretas.

Primeiro: porque é que, quando estão em causa setores industriais, como os setores industriais relevantes em Portugal — no têxtil, no setor automóvel, mesmo na produção de material elétrico —, nunca há medidas de proteção e vale sempre o mercado livre e a globalização, mesmo que isso arruíne a indústria portuguesa, e, quando está em causa a siderurgia alemã, já há medidas protecionistas?

A segunda pergunta: como é que se vai lidar com os impactos negativos sobre a indústria transformadora? Porque proteger a siderurgia alemã significa comprar aço mais caro do que aquilo que hoje se compra a outros fornecedores, com um impacto muito negativo em Portugal.

paragraphs.text: Senhor Deputado João Oliveira, começaria por responder à segunda pergunta. Creio que a resposta está na minha intervenção; manifestei essa mesma preocupação.

Nós temos uma indústria transformadora que pode ser prejudicada se não houver o cuidado de acompanhar e monitorizar com rigor a aplicação das medidas que vão agora ser aprovadas. E, portanto, creio que a Comissão Europeia tem agora aqui uma responsabilidade enorme que tem de prosseguir com sucesso.

Tenho consciência, por exemplo, que, no nosso país, Portugal, essa indústria transformadora é da maior importância e é responsável por grande parte das exportações portuguesas. Quanto à primeira questão, eu diria muito simplesmente que a tese a que aqui adiro é a tese da abertura, mas, por vezes, justifica-se algum protecionismo, como é evidente.

paragraphs.text: Monsieur le Président, le réveil auquel on assiste aujourd’hui est bien tardif. Pendant des années, ici même, on a entendu des responsables politiques louer l’ouverture du marché pendant que les autres puissances protégeaient massivement leurs industries stratégiques. Mais nous ne sommes pas dupes. Les dirigeants européens qui se sont succédé ont une grande part de responsabilité. Leur aveuglement sur la compétition mondiale féroce a largement pénalisé le secteur de l’acier. Pendant des années, nous avons laissé entrer massivement de l’acier chinois à bas prix, tout en imposant à nos producteurs des normes environnementales et énergétiques extrêmement coûteuses.

Nous n’oublions pas ces milliers d’ouvriers français qui ont vu leurs usines fermer, parfois après plusieurs générations de travail dans la sidérurgie, abandonnés du jour au lendemain, avec le sentiment que leur savoir-faire et leur sacrifice ne comptaient plus. Sans acier, il n’y a pas d’industrie forte, il n’y a pas de projet crédible de réindustrialisation. Il n’y a pas non plus d’autonomie stratégique ou de capacité de défense sérieuse. Il était temps de se réveiller. Mais ce réveil ne doit pas conduire à de nouvelles demi-mesures technocratiques. Face à une concurrence mondiale déloyale, il faut enfin assumer une véritable politique de protection économique. Osons enfin le protectionnisme européen et osons-le pour toutes nos industries, qu’elles soient en amont ou en aval, avant qu’il ne soit définitivement trop tard.

Nous n’oublions pas ces milliers d’ouvriers français qui ont vu leurs usines fermer, parfois après plusieurs générations de travail dans la sidérurgie, abandonnés du jour au lendemain, avec le sentiment que leur savoir-faire et leur sacrifice ne comptaient plus. Sans acier, il n’y a pas d’industrie forte, il n’y a pas de projet crédible de réindustrialisation. Il n’y a pas non plus d’autonomie stratégique ou de capacité de défense sérieuse. Il était temps de se réveiller. Mais ce réveil ne doit pas conduire à de nouvelles demi-mesures technocratiques. Face à une concurrence mondiale déloyale, il faut enfin assumer une véritable politique de protection économique. Osons enfin le protectionnisme européen et osons-le pour toutes nos industries, qu’elles soient en amont ou en aval, avant qu’il ne soit définitivement trop tard.

paragraphs.text: Voorzitter, commissaris, Europees staal is niet zomaar een grondstof. Het vormt de ruggengraat van onze Europese industrie. Als we onze staalsector verliezen, verliezen we de controle over onze toekomst.

De nieuwe beschermingsmaatregelen zijn daarom een belangrijke stap om oneerlijke concurrentie tegen te gaan, veelal uit China, die onze industrie ondermijnt via dumping en massale staatssteun. Dit is voor ons slechts een eerste stap. De hele waardeketen van staal dient te worden beschermd. Dat gaat ook over de vele, vaak kleine, verwerkende producenten die staal omzetten in hoogwaardige producten en jobs creëren. Zij mogen niet het onbedoelde slachtoffer worden van de maatregelen. Te hoge kosten of beperkte toegang tot grondstoffen dreigen hun concurrentievermogen teniet te doen.

Een evenwichtige aanpak is noodzakelijk, met doeltreffende bescherming waar nodig, met voldoende flexibiliteit en met strikte monitoring om negatieve effecten stroomafwaarts te vermijden. Laat ons daar werk van maken.

paragraphs.text: Voorzitter, als deze tijd ons iets leert, is het dat we het zélf moeten doen. We moeten op onszelf bouwen. Europa op eigen benen: onze eigen energie, onze eigen defensie en dus ook ons eigen staal.

De toekomst van Europees staal is groen staal. Onze bedrijven werken keihard aan die omschakeling en dat vraagt veel: flinke investeringen voor nieuwe installaties, het ontwikkelen van nieuwe kennis en het in gang zetten van die hele verbouwing.

Dan laten we onze markt toch niet ondermijnen door de dumping van vervuild staal uit China? Zie je het voor je: dat we zelf prachtig een hoogwaardig product maken, zoals houten speelgoed, en vervolgens onze kinderen volstoppen met goedkope Temu-troep? Of nog erger: dat we nog steeds smerig Russisch staal importeren waar Poetin de oorlog in Oekraïne mee financiert?

Nee, wij moeten de vraag creëren voor ons eigen mooie product. Met trots onze Europese auto’s van Europees groen staal op de markt brengen, die rijden op schone energie van windmolens die ook van groen staal zijn gemaakt. Made in the EU. Dat is onze boodschap naar onze staalindustrie, naar onze autoproducenten en onze vakmensen. Wij beschermen onszelf tegen goedkope, smerige overproductie. Samen maken we de stap mogelijk naar Europese schone industrie. Op naar de toekomst: met trots Europees gemaakt!

paragraphs.text: Señor presidente, hay que acabar con la competencia desleal que amenaza nuestra industria y que destruye empleos de calidad en Europa. Por eso, las medidas contra las sobrecapacidades y también la puesta en marcha del Mecanismo de Ajuste en Frontera por Carbono del acero son imprescindibles.

Gracias a estas medidas, el precio del acero extranjero se acercará —casi— al precio de la producción europea, protegiendo empleos aquí y también la salud en todo el planeta, porque cuando Europa actúa con valentía, Europa gana y el mundo se transforma.

Nuestras políticas no solo protegen la industria y los empleos europeos, sino que actúan como una palanca real para la transición verde global, y ya lo estamos viendo: en la India hay gigantes siderúrgicos que están invirtiendo en acero verde para poder entrar en mejores condiciones al mercado europeo, y países como Turquía o Brasil ya implementan sistemas de comercio de emisiones.

Ese es el camino; un camino que tenemos que ampliar, y tenemos que ser valientes también para ampliarlo a otras industrias estratégicas, porque la sobrecapacidad y la competencia desleal no solo afectan al problema del acero.

paragraphs.text: Pane předsedající, dámy a pánové, za každou tunou evropské oceli stojí tisíce lidí, teploty přes dva tisíce stupňů Celsia a je to jedna z nejnáročnějších profesí vůbec. Výroba oceli je tvrdá a strategicky důležitá práce pro celou Evropu. A to zvláště dnes, kdy Evropa mluví o větších investicích do obrany a naší bezpečnosti. Je to odvětví, kterého se v dnešním nejistém a nebezpečném světě nesmíme vzdát. Evropské ocelářství dnes čelí obrovskému tlaku levných dovozů. Čína například vyrábí levně a často za neférových podmínek. Evropa ale nesmí zaplatit ztrátou vlastních pracovních míst a strategického průmyslu. Proto podporuji zachování ochranných kvót na dovoz oceli do EU, zpřísnění obchodně-obranných nástrojů proti levným dovozcům i silnější ochranu evropských firem před neférovou konkurencí. Pro regiony jako Moravskoslezský kraj a pro lidi, kteří pracují v hutích v Třinci nebo Ostravě, je to otázka jejich živobytí. Je načase zastavit další oslabování evropského průmyslu a ztrátu pracovních míst.

paragraphs.text: Señor presidente, señor comisario, cuando hablamos del acero, hablamos de soberanía industrial, de empleos y del futuro de regiones como la mía —Asturias—, donde miles de familias dependen de la siderurgia.

Por eso, Europa ya no puede seguir ingenua frente a la sobrecapacidad china y la competencia desleal. No podemos exigir a nuestra industria más costes, más regulación, más exigencias climáticas, mientras permitimos la entrada de acero subvencionado que no cumple nuestros estándares ambientales, laborales o energéticos. Así es imposible competir.

Esto es lo que llevo tiempo reclamando en Bruselas y, además, me alegro de haber formado parte de esta negociación, porque el Reglamento que aprobamos hoy es un salvavidas para el sector: reduce las cuotas a la mitad, endurece los aranceles, refuerza el control para evitar fraudes y, además, entra en vigor ya, a partir del 1 de julio.

Pero también —como digo siempre— con esto solo no basta. Si queremos que la industria del acero se quede en Europa, necesitamos energía asequible, revisar el MAFC —el arancel en frontera— para que funcione de verdad y una política industrial que deje de castigar a quienes todavía producen, invierten y crean empleo en Europa.

political_group.label: PPE
political_group.name: Group of the European People's Party (Christian Democrats)

paragraphs.text: Monsieur le Président, chers collègues, Monsieur le Commissaire, l’Europe assume enfin qu’un marché ouvert n’a de sens que si les règles du jeu sont équitables et respectées par tous. Voilà des années que le marché de l’acier est livré à une concurrence sans raison et sans règle. Une surcapacité endémique menace notre industrie, alimentée par des productions massivement subventionnées, en particulier chinoises.

Pour y répondre, l’Europe va donc réduire de moitié les quotas d’importation d’acier à tarif réduit, et nous allons doubler les droits de douane hors quota de 25 à 50 %. Pour notre Union, ces choix marquent la fin de l’innocence en matière de libre-échange. Ils permettront de garantir notre souveraineté dans un secteur stratégique, de protéger nos travailleurs et nos savoir-faire et de donner à notre industrie les moyens de devenir un leader de l’acier décarboné.

Il faut désormais étendre ces sauvegardes à d’autres produits essentiels. Et, je vous le dis, elles ne seront pleinement efficaces que si elles sont accompagnées non pas, Madame Knafo, par la baisse des charges sociales qui sont des salaires différés, mais par un plan d’envergure de lutte contre la surproduction chinoise, par une loi de préférence européenne à la hauteur des enjeux et par un investissement massif dans la décarbonation.

Sur ce point, le prochain budget à long terme de l’Union n’est pas au rendez-vous. La raison est simple: il exclut le recours à l’emprunt commun pour financer ces investissements vitaux. C’est une erreur tragique qu’il est urgent de réparer pour que l’Europe protège ses travailleurs, le climat et sa souveraineté. Je termine en disant aussi que, pour que l’Europe n’agisse plus au nom du seul libre-échange, mais aussi du juste échange. Dans l’attente, célébrons ce vote.

political_group.label: S&D
political_group.name: Group of the Progressive Alliance of Socialists and Democrats in the European Parliament

paragraphs.text: Monsieur le Président, depuis des années, l’Europe ouvre grand ses portes à un acier produit à bas coûts, souvent dans des conditions que nous n’accepterions jamais chez nous. Résultat: nos industries ferment, nos ouvriers payent le prix de la naïveté bruxelloise et notre souveraineté industrielle disparaît morceau par morceau.

La surcapacité mondiale venue d’Asie n’est pas un simple déséquilibre économique; c’est une arme commerciale. Pendant que des États subventionnent massivement leur acier, l’Union européenne impose toujours plus de normes, de taxes et de contraintes à ses propres producteurs. Cette concurrence déloyale détruit notre marché intérieur.

Et pendant ce temps-là, que voyons-nous? Des sites historiques comme ArcelorMittal et d’autres marchent au ralenti. À Denain comme à Dunkerque, ce sont des centaines de familles qui vivent dans la peur de perdre leur emploi. Voilà la réalité concrète de cette mondialisation sans protection.

Mais aujourd’hui, enfin, l’Union européenne commence à se réveiller. Enfin, certains comprennent que sans protection industrielle, il n’y aura plus ni emploi, ni souveraineté, ni avenir pour nos territoires.

C’est pourquoi nous allons voter pour des mesures fortes, un véritable protectionnisme européen, des barrières commerciales contre le dumping étranger, une préférence européenne dans les marchés publics et la défense de notre acier stratégique. Nous allons voter pour une Europe qui défend ses usines, son savoir-faire et son indépendance industrielle. Nous allons voter pour une Europe qui cesse de subir et qui choisit enfin de défendre son peuple.

paragraphs.text: Panie Przewodniczący! Szanowni Państwo! Unię zalewa tania stal, produkowana bez żadnych obciążeń klimatycznych, z Rosji i Chin, z Indii, a dodatkowo w dużej skali od czerwca ubiegłego roku – również z Ukrainy. Czy państwo wiecie, że 46% dostaw ukraińskiej stali trafia bezpośrednio do Polski? Sytuacja w polskim przemyśle stalowym jest dramatyczna. Niestety, wprowadzone unijne środki zaradcze są niewystarczające. Tak więc europejska produkcja stali się kurczy. Unia traci konkurencyjność, a ludzie – miejsca pracy.

Polityka handlowa to nie jedyny sposób, aby ratować europejski sektor stalowy. Należy pilnie zrewidować politykę klimatyczną, która zabija potencjał gospodarczy Europy. Potrzebne są więc konkretne działania: likwidacja systemu ETS, a także skuteczny mechanizm CBAM, który realnie ochroni europejski rynek przed nieuczciwym importem stali spoza Unii. Bez silnego sektora stali nie możemy mówić o autonomii strategicznej Europy.

paragraphs.text: Mr President, colleagues, today we protect our steel industry and its workers from unfair competition, notably from China.

Today, our Union takes the lead in the global stage to tackle overcapacity in the steel sector. And today, for this, I'm especially proud we reaffirm that the green transition and trade defence instruments can and should go hand in hand. By securing the decarbonisation criterion in the negotiations, we have formally linked market protection to climate action. Cheap, unfair imports were freezing vital green investments. Companies couldn't compete. But now, by tying import quotas directly to our decarbonisation path, our steel companies no longer have to choose between going green or surviving. We are making clean steel economically viable.

As the Greens/EFA Group, we fought for and are very proud of securing consideration for labour conventions and the Paris Agreement into this framework. We're not just protecting our workers at home; we are raising the standards for human dignity around the world. This is how you build a truly just transition.

Finally, we are closing loopholes. Thanks to the 'melt and pour' rule we fought for, third countries cannot bypass our defences. If China tries to remelt its steel elsewhere and disguise it for European market, it will not work. This is a bold first step towards rethinking the rules-of-origin logic at the WTO.
This is more than just steel. This is about how Europe leads – by building an economy that is as fair to its people as it is to the planet.

paragraphs.text: Mr President, Commissioner, global overcapacity is expected to reach 721 million tonnes by 2027. When we speak about European steel, we speak about 300 000 jobs across Europe. But we also need precision and proportionality. Not all trading partners contribute to global overcapacity in the same way. We must pay particular attention to candidate countries that are progressively integrated into European markets and aligning with the EU acquis.

Moreover, countries such as Switzerland – our fourth trading partner and we shouldn't upset these people so much now – are deeply integrated into European supply chains and are not the source of these distortions. paragraphs.text: Domnule președinte, domnule comisar, stimați colegi, de votul nostru de mâine privind regulamentul care stabilește viitorul industriei siderurgice europene depinde și soarta a zeci de mii de familii de muncitori români și europeni.

De asemenea, decizia noastră va depăși limitele unei piețe economice și va hotărî securitatea economică a Uniunii, posibilitatea Europei de a continua să producă și suveranitatea sa industrială. Pe lângă pierderea în timp a aproximativ 100 000 de locuri de muncă în industria siderurgică europeană, Uniunea Europeană și, implicit, țara mea, România, se confruntă acum cu trei amenințări majore.

Primul pericol este generat de concurența globală neloială și supracapacitatea mondială de producție. La acestea se adaugă costurile uriașe ale energiei și ale producției, dar și posibilitatea pierderii autonomiei strategice europene. Și fără o industrie siderurgică puternică, Europa devine dependentă de importuri pentru infrastructură, apărare, energie, transport și construcții.

Piața oțelului din Europa se află într-un moment de răscruce. Avem nevoie de sprijin financiar comunitar atât pentru modernizarea combinatelor siderurgice din România și din întreaga Uniune, cât și pentru protejarea locurilor de muncă și formarea unei noi generații de lucrători în industriile strategice.
Dacă vrem o Uniune Europeană puternică, competitivă și independentă, atunci trebuie să apărăm industria siderurgică europeană și pe cei care muncesc în ea.

paragraphs.text: Monsieur le Président, depuis des années, vous ignorez ceux qui défendent nos industries, nos ouvriers et nos usines. Mais aujourd’hui, vous découvrez enfin ce que nous dénonçons depuis trop longtemps: nos entreprises subissent une concurrence déloyale venant de pays qui ne respectent ni nos normes, ni nos salariés, ni même les règles environnementales que vous imposez pourtant à nos propres industries.

Même si les mesures de protection annoncées vont dans le bon sens, elles restent largement insuffisantes. Sous la pression de certains lobbys, le silicium métal a été exclu de ces protections. Pourquoi? Et avec quelles conséquences? L’usine FerroGlobe de Montricher en Savoie est aujourd’hui en grande difficulté à cause de la concurrence déloyale chinoise. Derrière vos décisions, ce sont des emplois menacés, des familles inquiètes et des savoir-faire industriels qui vont disparaître.

Et je m’étonnerai toujours de voir certaines familles politiques comme les Républicains, venir sur le terrain, jouer les défenseurs de nos usines, mais qui, ici même dans cet hémicycle, votent ou accompagnent les politiques européennes qui détruisent nos industries. D’ailleurs, où sont-ils au moment de défendre concrètement nos salariés? La vérité est simple: on ne protège pas nos usines avec des discours ou des visites d’usines le temps d’une photo. On les protège avec des actes et avec du courage politique.
Nous devons reprendre le contrôle de notre politique industrielle et énergétique pour défendre nos emplois, nos usines et l’avenir de nos territoires.

paragraphs.text: Domnule președinte, stimați colegi, reducerea importurilor de oțel este un lucru bun. Din păcate, too little too late.

Ne aflăm astăzi în fața unui raport care încearcă să pună un plasture pe o rană adâncă până la os. Era bine dacă aceste tarife erau introduse înainte de pandemie și poate în felul acesta, 100 000 de europeni care lucrează în industria siderurgică nu și-ar fi pierdut locurile de muncă. Spre exemplu, în România, gigantul Liberty Galați a oprit producția și a trimis oamenii acasă.

Este o lecție la mijloc: când doctorul vine la căpătâiul pacientului după ce acesta a fost îmbălsămat, tratamentul nu mai valorează nimic. Deci, repet, introducerea acestor tarife reprezintă un lucru bun, dar vreau să atrag atenția asupra a trei lucruri.

1. Nu rezolvăm problema dacă insistăm, din rațiuni ideologice, pe oțelul verde. Vom construi artificial o bulă, vom pierde competitivitate în mod accelerat și fierul beton și structurile metalice vor deveni produse de lux, omorând și construcțiile.
2. E nevoie de injecție directă de resurse în producătorii de oțel europeni. Era bine dacă o parte din fondurile SAFE erau folosite explicit pentru facilități fiscale.
3. Trebuie să vedem facilitățile acelea oferite Ucrainei, pentru că în România, magnații oțelului din țara vecină au ieșit la pescuit de combinate.

paragraphs.text: Panie Przewodniczący! Szanowni Państwo! Jesteśmy tu po to, żeby nie tylko opisywać problemy, ale także je rozwiązywać. Wydaje mi się, że obecna propozycja jest propozycją idącą we właściwym kierunku. Szukamy właściwego mechanizmu do tego, aby przede wszystkim ograniczyć nieuczciwy import stali, i to w skali opisanej chyba dość dobrze.

Musimy jednak przy tej okazji powiedzieć dwie rzeczy. Pierwsza: ten mechanizm, który jest proponowany, będzie rzeczywiście skuteczny tylko wtedy, kiedy będzie rzeczywiście szczelny. Jeżeli będzie szczelny, będzie wówczas efektywny. Jest druga kwestia, o której trzeba powiedzieć. To jest kwestia, w jaki sposób będzie dokonywała się alokacja kontyngentów dla państw trzecich. Jeżeli ta zasada alokacji będzie identyczna dla wszystkich krajów, bez wyjątków, bez dodatkowych derogacji, to ona będzie skutecznym mechanizmem. Jeżeli zaczniemy budować derogacje, niestety ten mechanizm nam się zawali. Zwracam na to uwagę już teraz.

paragraphs.text: Señor presidente, señor comisario, el acero es un sector estratégico para nuestra soberanía industrial. El exceso de capacidad y producción a nivel mundial y la competencia desleal están ejerciendo una presión insoportable sobre el acero europeo, y amenazan también a otros sectores industriales que son esenciales.

Europa necesita actuar con determinación. Necesitamos más transparencia en el mercado mundial del acero. Necesitamos defender el acero verde de bajas emisiones, así como las cadenas de suministro seguras. Necesitamos mayor coordinación entre socios internacionales para garantizar una competencia justa con mirada de largo plazo.

Europa tiene una larga tradición siderúrgica. Detrás de cada tonelada de acero hay personas altamente cualificadas, empleos estables bien remunerados, con un enorme valor social para nuestras regiones industriales. Defender el acero es defender nuestra capacidad productiva, nuestro liderazgo tecnológico y el futuro del empleo de calidad industrial. Y esa defensa debe ir acompañada de una apuesta clara por la descarbonización, con políticas industriales ambiciosas, inversiones estratégicas y acuerdos comerciales coherentes con nuestros objetivos climáticos e industriales. Así que apoyemos más el «Made in Europe».

paragraphs.text: Monsieur le Président, mieux vaut tard que jamais. Nous saluons votre réveil face à la crise de la sidérurgie. Mais le responsable de cet effondrement n’est pas en Asie: c’est votre dogmatisme. Vous avez créé ce désastre dans toutes ses dimensions. Économiquement d’abord. Le rapport de la Commission sur le commerce international le prouve: les coûts de nos producteurs ont explosé de 35 % depuis 2022, écrasés par votre marché carbone et le sabotage délibéré de notre filière nucléaire.

Stratégiquement ensuite. Quelle hypocrisie! Vous dénoncez la concurrence déloyale, mais vous importez l’acier étranger dont votre pacte vert a un besoin vital pour ses éoliennes. Socialement, enfin, ce sont nos ouvriers qui payent la facture.

Les solutions sont claires. Premièrement, l’arrêt de l’écologie punitive et le retour à une énergie nucléaire compétitive. Deuxièmement, un patriotisme économique assumé, loin de votre libre-échange sauvage. Mieux vaut tard que jamais pour ouvrir les yeux, laissez nos entreprises et nos usines produire!

paragraphs.text: Voorzitter, commissaris, collega’s, de CEO van een belangrijke staalproducent in Europa gaf in maart van vorig jaar een interview in de krant “De Tijd”. Hij zei toen dat we nog één jaar hebben, één jaar om de staalindustrie in Europa te redden. Begin dit jaar verscheen er opnieuw een interview van diezelfde CEO, die intussen wat optimistischer klonk. Ik citeer: “Europa is wakker geworden. Ik sluit niet uit dat de staalsector in Europa opnieuw kan groeien.”

Zijn vandaag alle uitdagingen voor de energie-intensieve staalsectoren opgelost? Natuurlijk niet. Er is de problematiek van de energie, de vergunningen, de administratieve last en de downstreamsector die vaak onbeschermd blijft. We hebben echter bewezen dat we industrieel beleid kunnen voeren en dat dit kan leiden tot nieuwe investeringen. We moeten beschermen zonder af te schermen. Laat ons de lessen trekken voor de staalverwerkers, maar ook voor de andere sectoren. We bewijzen vandaag dat het wel degelijk kan.

paragraphs.text: Señor presidente, señor comisario, la verdad es que hoy es un día para estar razonablemente satisfechos después de una negociación exprés que viene a proteger la producción del acero en Europa, de la siderurgia en nuestro continente, con una propuesta valiente por parte de la Comisión —que yo creo que hay que poner en valor— y con un trabajo eficiente por parte de esta Cámara.

Ahora bien, aún nos quedan asuntos pendientes. En primer lugar, me gustaría usar este atril para exigir que las compañías privadas que han estado demorando sus inversiones, esperando a conocer el sistema de salvaguardias que Europa iba a adoptar, en estos momentos reactiven sus inversiones. Llevamos largo tiempo poniendo medidas —desde la Comisión, desde el Parlamento— para apoyar el sector industrial y, especialmente, la producción de acero y es el momento de que las empresas privadas respondan a este esfuerzo colectivo del sector público.

Por otra parte, queda también pendiente —y aquí la Comisión tiene un papel central— la definición del acero bajo en carbono. Realmente, las políticas para fortalecer la producción y la compra de acero en Europa necesitan una aclaración sobre qué es el acero bajo en carbono y cómo debe producirlo Europa.

interventions.text: Catch-the-eye procedure

paragraphs.text: Panie Przewodniczący! Bez europejskiej stali nie ma europejskiej gospodarki. I bardzo dobrze, że Europa się dzisiaj budzi, podnosi cła dwukrotnie na tę stal, która przyjeżdża do Unii Europejskiej. Europa się budzi, bo chodzi o konkurencyjność, chodzi o miejsca pracy, ale też chodzi o bezpieczeństwo gospodarcze.

A dziś wszyscy wiemy, że europejscy producenci mierzą się z nieuczciwą konkurencją spoza Unii Europejskiej z uwagi między innymi na wysokie koszty energii. I Europa nie może zamykać hut, a jednocześnie importować spoza Unii Europejskiej stal, którą się produkuje taniej. Dlatego transformacja energetyczna „Tak”, ale musi być sprawiedliwa. Zielona Europa nie może oznaczać de-industrializacji Europy.

A wiem, co mówię, bo polska stal między innymi budowała europejską gospodarkę przez ostatnie dekady od infrastruktury, przez motoryzację, po sektor obronny i energetyczny. Dlatego też ochrona europejskiej stali to obrona miejsc pracy, to między innymi bezpieczeństwo dostaw, ale też konkurencyjność naszej gospodarki.

paragraphs.text: Domnule președinte, domnule comisar, siderurgia trebuie protejată și nu trebuia de astăzi. Supracapacitatea producției de oțel global se știa și n-am luat la timp măsuri, dar măcar acum să încercăm să punem capăt dumpingului importului de oțel.

S-au pierdut sute de mii de locuri de muncă, zeci de mii de locuri de muncă. În țara mea, în România, mii de locuri de muncă au fost pierdute. Oamenii din combinatele siderurgice au trebuit să plece acasă.

Și de ce? Pentru că avem un import cu preț de dumping, pentru că avem derogări la importurile din Rusia, pentru că nu utilizăm ceea ce alte state utilizează. Și trebuie și noi să trecem, să utilizăm, să mergem pe made in Europe, să ținem cont că siderurgia influențează toate celelalte industrii și toate celelalte costuri. Și o industrie europeană puternică nu poate să fie fără siderurgie.

De aceea, domnule comisar, trebuie să trecem la fapte, pentru că doar prin declarații nu putem să creăm locuri de muncă, nu putem să protejăm siderurgia din Europa și, de aceea, cred că acest raport este binevenit și trebuie votat.

paragraphs.text: Mr President, dear Commissioner, the European economy cannot survive with slogans. And that's what we heard today from many MEPs from the Left and even from you, Commissioner.

We heard today being said that we need, and I quote, 'green steel'. What does that mean? In order to produce green steel, are we going to need 'green heat' or 'green coal'? How are you going to produce this green steel? Someone from the S&D just said, and I quote, 'We need a definition for low-carbon steel'. So instead of resolving the problem, we run into another debate about definitions.
In 1946, after the Second World War, the Western world produced 26 % of the steel. In 2025, the European Union – with more countries – is producing 6.8 % of the world's steel.
Now the question to you, Commissioner, is what are you going to do to make sure to make sure that the price of energy is lower and we bring back production of steel in Europe?

paragraphs.text: Mr President, now you catch me a little bit off guard, I thought I am not on the speaker's list, but it does not matter. I am here to speak. I am paid to speak. I can do a speech.

Dear people of Europe, I think the European steel market is one of the most important areas of our economy, not only because it brought this Union together, historically speaking. It was the agreement on steel, on the shared production of steel between France and Germany, that led to the first steps of the European integration.

But also because it serves as an example on how we have a necessity to make it possible for our industry, for our workers, for our small and medium enterprises to transition into the new era that we need so desperately.
And yes, dear colleagues, this means green steel. And for green steel you need green energy and a lot of other green things. I think we are perfectly capable of doing that.

Last but not least, regrettably, we are also living in an era of war, so if we want it or not, a vibrant European steel sector might be of utmost importance in the future. I am happy that the Commission is willing to take the necessary steps and I hope you all liked this very spontaneous speech.

paragraphs.text: Monsieur le Président, d’abord, quand même mon étonnement par rapport au fait que, dans un débat sur la sidérurgie, la Commission envoie le commissaire responsable de la pêche. Je ne suis pas sûr que les travailleurs vont comprendre ce choix-là, je dois être honnête.

Deuxièmement, la crise de la sidérurgie en Europe frappe durement les travailleurs. Alors, il ne faut pas raconter des bêtises non plus. Je veux dire, on parle tous de la surproduction en Chine, mais moi, quand je parle aux travailleurs, ils me disent ArcelorMittal, pour prendre un exemple, délocalise en Inde. Et que fait l’Europe? Un accord de libre-échange avec l’Inde? Et ça, c’est vraiment du n’importe quoi quand même?

Troisièmement, c’est quoi un vrai souci? C’est la question des prix de l’énergie. Depuis qu’on a remplacé le gaz russe – parce qu’on ne pouvait plus le prendre – par le gaz américain, on a un problème de coûts de l’énergie pour l’industrie. Si on ne prend pas publiquement en main l’énergie et le secteur de l’énergie, on ne va pas s’en sortir. L’acier n’aura pas d’avenir en Europe. Il faut dire clairement les choses aux gens quand même.

Et finalement, ce n’est pas avec les programmes de militarisation qu’on va s’en sortir. Parce que 1 000 chars, même 1 000 chars, c’est trois jours de production pour une usine sidérurgique. Donc cela ne sauvera pas notre industrie.

paragraphs.text: Poštovani predsjedavajući, povjereniče, europska industrija čelika danas je pod snažnim pritiskom globalnih prekomjernih kapaciteta i nelojalne konkurencije. Zato podržavam jačanje zaštitnih mjera Europske unije, strože kontrole podrijetla čelika i snažniju obranu našeg tržišta. No, ovu raspravu moramo povezati i sa svakodnevnim životom naših građana. Posljednjih godina svjedočimo snažnom rastu cijena čelika i građevinskog materijala, što se izravno prelijeva na rast troškova gradnje i cijena stanova diljem Europe. Eurostat bilježi da su proizvođačke cijene novih stambenih zgrada u Europskoj uniji porasle za čak 52 %. Zato pitanje konkurentnosti europske industrije čelika danas postaje pitanje priuštivog stanovanja, a industrijska politika, konkurentnost i stambena sigurnost naših građana više nisu odvojene teme – one su dio iste europske odgovornosti.

political_group.name: Group of the European People's Party (Christian Democrats)

paragraphs.text: Arvoisa puhemies, Kiina uhkaa Euroopan terästeollisuutta.
Kiinan kommunistipuoluetta ei EU-kommunistien Green Dealit rajoita, ei suinkaan. Sen sijaan Kiina vyöryttää pää punaisena halpaterästä maailmanmarkkinoille.

Kiina tuotti edellisvuoden tilastojen perusteella yli tuhat miljoonaa tonnia raakaterästä. Se on enemmän kuin kaikilla muilla maailman mailla yhteensä, ja se on noin 27 kertaa enemmän kuin EU:n suurimmalla tuottajamaalla Saksalla.

Kun tämä Kiinan kommunistiteräs sitten vyöryy Eurooppaan, omat tuottajamme ovat lirissä. Eurooppalainen terästeollisuus taistelee ensin eurooppalaisen sääntelyvyöryn ja ilmastovaatimusten kanssa, jonka jälkeen kiinalainen teräsvyöry lyö loputkin ilmat pihalle.
Vapaakauppa on hieno ja kannatettava asia, mutta Euroopan terästeollisuuden selviytyminen vaatii nyt tätä: kiinalaista terästuontia Eurooppaan on rajoitettava.

paragraphs.text: Senhor Presidente, Senhor Comissário Kadis, os defensores das políticas liberais e neoliberais vêm hoje defender medidas protecionistas do setor da siderurgia no espaço da União Europeia porque, afinal de contas, o mercado livre, funcionando livremente, pode destruir a capacidade de produção de aço na União Europeia. E é óbvio que isso é assim porque os mercados não são livres e porque, quando os mercados funcionam e põem em causa a produção, têm de se tomar medidas de proteção dessa produção, seja ela industrial ou outra.

O problema é que o que está hoje em causa mostra que os Estados-Membros não são todos iguais dentro da União Europeia: quando está em causa a produção industrial portuguesa no setor têxtil, no setor automóvel, no material elétrico, não há medidas de proteção; quando está em causa a produção do aço da Alemanha e da Itália, que juntas representam mais de 50 % da produção do aço da União Europeia, aparece a preocupação com a indústria, aparecem as medidas protecionistas, e lá se vai à vida o mercado livre.

E é preciso, Senhor Comissário, ter em conta os impactos que estas medidas têm na indústria transformadora. Porque, se estas medidas forem por diante, o que vai acontecer é que a indústria transformadora vai ter de comprar à Alemanha aço mais caro do que aquele que compra hoje a outros fornecedores, e isso também não é defender a produção industrial nesses setores transformadores.

interventions.speaker_label: Costas Kadis, Member of the Commission.

paragraphs.text: Mr President, honourable Members, thank you for sharing your views on this important topic and for the engaging debate. We have taken note of all your comments, which will be also conveyed to Commissioner Šefčovič, who, due to very important commitments, could not be with us today.

I am pleased to hear the broad recognition of the urgency to act decisively in view of the very difficult situation our steel industry is facing. The measure aims to offer security, predictability and the necessary flexibility to our steel sector and to our downstream businesses while respecting our commitments to our partners.

One comment on Ukraine – let me stress that the EU stands firmly with Ukraine and its people and it has provided substantial economic, humanitarian and military support. The EU needs the strong steel industry to increase its military and defence capabilities and to continue offering support to Ukraine.

To ensure a level playing field, including between candidate countries and FTA partners and to maintain the effectiveness of the steel measure, it must apply erga omnes, including to exports from our closest partners, such as Ukraine. This decision was not taken lightly, but it is necessary, given that around 80 % of imports come from our FTA partners, who are seeking to sell their steel on third markets, as their industries also face global overcapacity.

Despite the ongoing war, Ukraine is the seventh-largest steel supplier to the EU. Given its status, Ukraine will receive a country-specific quota that guarantees continued steel exports to the EU are paid at levels lower than before the war. In line with the steel measure proposal, when setting the Ukraine's quota, we will take into account its exceptional and immediate security situation.

Honourable Members, it is now crucial to act to ensure that our industry is protected from the negative effects of global steel overcapacity. Therefore, the entry into force of the measure on the 1 July 2026 is the key priority and I count on you to ensure that we achieve that goal together.

Mr President, honourable Members, thank you for sharing your views on this important topic and for the engaging debate. We have taken note of all your comments, which will be also conveyed to Commissioner Šefčovič, who, due to very important commitments, could not be with us today.

The measure aims to offer security, predictability and the necessary flexibility to our steel sector and to our downstream businesses while respecting our commitments to our partners.

One comment on Ukraine – let me stress that the EU stands firmly with Ukraine and its people and it has provided substantial economic, humanitarian and military support. The EU needs the strong steel industry to increase its military and defence capabilities and to continue offering support to Ukraine.

To ensure a level playing field, including between candidate countries and FTA partners and to maintain the effectiveness of the steel measure, it must apply erga omnes, including to exports from our closest partners, such as Ukraine. This decision was not taken lightly, but it is necessary, given that around 80 % of imports come from our FTA partners, who are seeking to sell their steel on third markets, as their industries also face global overcapacity.

Given its status, Ukraine will receive a country-specific quota that guarantees continued steel exports to the EU are paid at levels lower than before the war. But let me come back to Ukraine. I am not fully reassured by the Commission; I am rather worried from what I hear. Ukraine is under attack. Colleagues, right now, at this very moment, there is another flight alarm over the steel plants in Kryvyi Rih, in Dnipro and Kamianske. Right now, while we are having this debate, thousands of steelworkers have to protect themselves in underground shelters.

Several production facilities are located in occupied areas or have been completely destroyed. Let us move into an integrated steel market.

Eficiența acestui mecanism era, deja, compromisă de intervențiile din ultimii ani de pe piață, așa cum a fost cazul unor impuneri de taxe vamale asupra importurilor de oțel. Dincolo de acest volum, se vor aplica taxe vamale de 50%, duble față de prezent.
